title: The Teaching of Vimalakirti (Toh 176, Thurman trans.)
description: The Vimalakirti scripture presents a lay bodhisattva whose insight challenges conventional assumptions about wisdom and spiritual authority. Its dialogues explore nonduality, compassion and skilful means within Mahayana Buddhism.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/).
